title: Preferable
summary: PREF'ERABLE, adjective Worthy to be preferred or chosen before something else; more eligible; more desirable. Virtue is far preferable to vice, even for its pleasures in this life. 1. More excellent;

inlines.v: PREF'ERABLE, adjective Worthy to be preferred or chosen before something else; more eligible; more desirable. Virtue is far preferable to vice, even for its pleasures in this life. 1. More excellent; of better quality; as, Madeira wine is preferable to claret.
